subject: ACME - Procurement & Security qualification / PO vs Card
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement/security checklist (quick recap & next steps)

Thanks for taking the time earlier, Sam and Tom — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the commercial path and security gating items: 

- Procurement preference: Sam mentioned procurement usually requires a PO for platform purchases but is sometimes able to process by corporate card for pilot projects. Please confirm which path ACME prefers for an initial POC (PO vs card).
- Marketplace interest: you asked about purchasing via cloud marketplace to simplify invoicing — we support both AWS and GCP marketplaces; if you want that route we can loop in Partnerships to confirm listing/contract terms.
- Security/compliance: attached SOC 2 summary and our standard DPA. The team noted a short security questionnaire — happy to triage answers.
- Next steps: 1) Sam to confirm procurement route and procurement contact, 2) Marissa to share DPA & SOC2 summary, 3) schedule a short procurement/finance call next week if needed.

Attaching: Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf, SOC2_Summary_Q4_2025.pdf, and a short procurement checklist (spreadsheet).

If that aligns I'll follow up with a short calendar invite and the DocuSign link for the DPA if you want to accelerate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0143


From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@acme.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement/security checklist (quick recap & next steps)

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few notes from procurement: 

- For the initial POC we can pay by corporate card (up to $25k) to speed things up. If we go beyond that scale we'll need a PO and SOW.
- I'll introduce you to our procurement contact (ProcureOps) — looped above — they handle PO routing and standard legal review.
- Regarding security: we will need answers to a short questionnaire (~20 items) and a signed DPA. Can you confirm whether the DPA is negotiable or if you require corporate legal to run through changes?

Can we schedule a 30-min call Thursday to include ProcureOps and legal? Tom — are you available?

Thanks,
Sam
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Corp
Samantha.Green@acme.com


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: ProcureOps <procure@acme.com>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Intro + procurement/security checklist (quick recap & next steps)

Hi ProcureOps team — looping you in. Quick answers to Sam's Qs: 

- Card vs PO: card for POC (<= $25k) is fine; for anything longer-term we'll route via PO and standard order form.
- DPA: attaching our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf). I'm happy to run any redlines through our legal team; small clarifications we can often accommodate but material changes will require legal review.
- Security questionnaire: we have a short answers pack and a SOC2 summary attached; Nikhil (cc'd, head of InfoSec) will pick up any technical Qs.

Next step — can we book Thu 2/12 10:00am PT for a 30-minute sync? I'll send a calendar invite. If that doesn't work suggest a time.

Thanks,
Marissa

[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf]
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, ProcureOps <procure@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement/security checklist (technical notes)

Hi Sam — quick technical notes ahead of our call: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2025; the one-page summary is attached (SOC2_Summary_Q4_2025.pdf). We can provide the full report under NDA if needed.
- Data residency & retention: by default customer data is stored in US regions; we offer EU-only options for EU customers. Retention and deletion workflows can be configured via the Console and are covered in the DPA.
- Questionnaire: if you can share the 20-item questionnaire we’ll aim to provide answers within 48 business hours. For items that require evidence (config screenshots, policy docs) we'll attach those in a follow-up.

Looking forward to the call — I've blocked 10:00am PT on my calendar.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of InfoSec | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@acme.com>, ProcureOps <procure@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement/security checklist (next steps & DocuSign)

Thanks all — great sync this morning. Quick follow-ups and commitments from Redwood: 

- Sam / ProcureOps: confirmed POC on card (<= $25k). When you're ready I'll share an invoice and card payment link.
- DPA: I've sent the DocuSign envelope for the attached Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf (link: https://www.docusign.com/sandbox/envelope/ABCDEF123456). We can accept minor redlines; anything material will need legal review.
- Questionnaire: Sam to share the 20-item questionnaire; Nikhil and team will return answers + evidence within 48 business hours of receipt.
- Marketplace: Tom — you mentioned marketplace would reduce procurement friction. If ACME prefers AWS Marketplace we can start the listing conversation; Partnerships will need a ~2-week lead to finalize commercial terms.

Attached: procurement-next-steps.xlsx (action items & owners).

I'll follow up with the invoice link and DocuSign reminder later today. Thanks again — excited to get the POC started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0143

[Attachments: procurement-next-steps.xlsx]
